instruction: Set up AI-powered content suggestions and auto-completion that predicts the next paragraph based on writing context and style.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because LibreOffice Writer does not have AI-powered content generation or predictive text features that can suggest full paragraphs. While LibreOffice has basic word completion, it cannot use machine learning models to predict contextual content or writing style, especially in the isolated OSWorld environment without internet access.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - LibreOffice Writer does not have AI-powered paragraph prediction or content generation features
The use of 'infeasible' evaluator function is semantically correct for impossible tasks

No verification logic is needed since the instruction describes an impossible operation
